title: From the Vault: Angels: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Wrath is no vice when inflicted upon the deserving."
Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.
A golden helix streaked skyward from the Helvault. A thunderous explosion shattered the silver monolith and Avacyn emerged, free from her prison at last.
Some angels protect the meek and innocent. Others seek out and smite evil wherever it lurks.
No more shall the righteous cower before evil.
She enraptures all, encompasses all, endures all.
Wounded soldiers looked up, grateful for her appearance. But she passed over them, her eyes firmly on their foe.
She is the apex of the artificer's craft, the spirit of the divine called out of base metal.
Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.
"After death you face paradise, damnation, or Tariel." —Priest's teaching
